title: Klocke-2024-supraspinal-10.1093/brain/awae223
description: This dataset contains multimodal recordings from 12 patients with idiopathic Parkinson's disease and bilateral subthalamic nucleus deep brain stimulation (Medtronic Percept PC). It includes bipolar STN local field potentials, 48-channel scalp EEG with surface EMG, and inertial sensor data. Recordings were made during sitting, standing, walking, walking with stops and dual-task walking, after overnight withdrawal of dopaminergic medication with stimulation off. The data support research on supraspinal mechanisms of freezing of gait.
methods_description: STN local field potentials were streamed from the Percept BrainSense at 250 Hz. Scalp EEG (48 channels) and 8 surface EMG channels were recorded with a Brain Products system at 1000 Hz. Three APDM Opal inertial sensors (lumbar spine and both legs/feet) were sampled at 128 Hz. Patients were recorded off dopaminergic medication and with stimulation off while sitting, standing, walking through a narrow corridor, walking with self-initiated stops and walking with a serial subtraction dual task.
